name: Aether Bloom: Airship Yuri
source:
A short visual novel about finding love while working on an airship traversing the aether. 

You are a servant, helping to ferry clockwork performers to a royal soirée. If you get a date to the soirée… you get a night off work. Get to know your crewmates and win their hearts by helping them out and spending time with them.

[Edited from [url=https://artgalles.itch.io/aether-bloom-airship-yuri]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于在穿越以太的飞艇上工作时寻找爱情的短篇视觉小说。

你是一名仆人，帮助运送发条表演者去皇家晚会。如果你有约会对象参加晚会……你就可以休息一晚。了解你的船员并通过帮助他们并与他们共度时光来赢得他们的心。

[编辑自[url=https://artgalles.itch.io/aether-bloom-airship-yuri]itch.io[/url]]
